The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) sits at a desk, looking flat and tired. SAME blue-gray glass-walled office (glass panels, blue code monitor, potted plant). scenes.name: s5_terminated
scenes.keyframe: Medium two-shot. Exactly TWO people: the ENGINEER has SHORT DARK HAIR (he is NOT bald, no hair tufts) and sits at his desk; only the BOSS is bald with two spiky hair tufts. No duplicate of the boss anywhere. The ENGINEER (round black glasses, white shirt, thin black tie) has a completely flat, emotionless expression. scenes.end_keyframe: Final frame, same setup as the attached start frame: The BOSS stands with BOTH HANDS CLAMPED OVER HIS OWN MOUTH, eyes enormous with horror. The ENGINEER sits at his desk, face totally blank, MOUTH FULLY CLOSED. Same office, same lighting, same camera framing as the start frame. scenes.action: ONLY THE ENGINEER SPEAKS IN THIS SCENE — the boss never talks and his mouth NEVER opens. The engineer, face totally blank, says flatly: "Well, since it thinks exactly like you, it just auto-terminated our oldest employee." The boss whips his head toward the engineer in alarm and CLAPS BOTH HANDS OVER HIS OWN MOUTH, keeping them clamped there, mouth completely covered, for the rest of the scene. The engineer looks him dead in the eye and adds: "You. Effective immediately." Only the engineer's mouth ever moves.
lines: Well, since it thinks exactly like you, it just auto-terminated our oldest employee.
